同じ77勝なのに、one team is one step from the title, the other 13.5 games back

On October 2, 2026, Hanshin had 77 wins and a magic number of one, while Seibu also had 77 wins but sat 13.5 games behind Pacific League leader SoftBank. Same number of wins, radically different meaning. This essay uses that oddity to explain games behind, magic numbers, and why metrics only make sense inside the system that generates them.
